entries.title: Tormented Souls

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best fidelity/capture route for Tormented Souls, while PlayStation, Xbox, and Switch have no sourced exclusive content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Tormented Souls on Steam for the primary route. Use PS5, Xbox Series, PS4, Xbox One, or Switch only for platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original first entry; no remake/remaster distinction applies.
